gate: Independent acceptance of frozen live Persona-task comparison evidence
scope: The bounded experiment and its descriptive projections are accepted with 35 valid trials and 1 preserved invalid trial. This does not establish human fidelity, statistical significance, a stable Persona effect, or overall repository regression success.

acceptance.criterion: Raw source, input identity, models, profile, all 36 final HTTP replays, ledgers, frames, and all 657 live hashes
acceptance.expected: Frozen producer identity and sealed raw files; exact trial identities; accounting and client HTTP timing bound; no retries or unauthorized writes.
acceptance.actual: All 36 raw trials replay with finalVisualHTTP=true. Ledger sum is 292 with one attempt per request and no overlapping request intervals. All initial product/current PNGs and source-backed reconstructed native HTTP bodies match within each task after removing Persona only. All 177 runtime source bytes and 657 live files rehash unchanged.

acceptance.criterion: Actual selected model distributions and unit weights
acceptance.expected: No non-unit applied weights or policy overrides; performed action matches selected control.
acceptance.actual: All 97 selected judgments have unit applied weights, exact selected/actual action binding, categorical modelChoice equal to selected, and no exclusions/adjustments. Snapshot event deltas match actual successful UI actions.

acceptance.expected: Isolated malformed output remains an invalid slot with its prefix preserved, excluded before path statistics, with no replacement or repair.
acceptance.actual: Sessions B repeat 2 has an HTTP 200 gpt-6-luna output at step 3 repeating o1_c1 three times. Continuity schema permits all three supplied IDs. Admission rejects it; its two successful UI actions remain in partial evidence, objective true is separate, and the trial is absent from valid distances. The next planned trial continued.

acceptance.criterion: Independent route metrics, counter projections, CSV and same-image comparisons
acceptance.expected: Valid-only paths by task, with missing valid B repeat 2 explicit, and no full-input claim from same PNG.
acceptance.actual: Independent raw reconstruction agrees with analyzer and comparison-results projections. Sessions: 11 valid, 10 within pairs and 45 between pairs, both mean 0. Preferences: 12 valid, 12 within and 54 between, both mean 0. Privacy: 12 valid, within mean 1/6 and between mean 1/3. Corrected CSV parser verifies all 36 rows and 22 columns. All observed targets match on shared PNGs; generated candidate annotations differ, so strict distribution-TV comparisons number 0.

acceptance.criterion: Actual visual review and grounds for Persona interpretation
acceptance.expected: Inspect all 8 selected unique delivered PNGs, all C privacy repetitions and extra baseline completion frames; separate exposure, observation, self-report and inference.
acceptance.actual: 14 cases and 28 frame references reproduce the exploratory plan. All 8 unique selected PNGs plus 2 extra delivered baseline completion PNGs were viewed. C privacy repeats 1 and 3 opened details and enabled its default basic scope, without pressing scope-basic; repeat 2 enabled extended scope. The UI explicitly describes optional extra fields, fictional data and no external data transfer. No hard trait violation follows from the extended choice.

acceptance.criterion: Browser safety and fresh context evidence
acceptance.expected: Local read-only fixture operations with no external data writes or prior session cookies.
acceptance.actual: All 36 new trace.network files contain 1800 browser resource records; all are local GET/HEAD or empty intercepted font stylesheets. No existing request cookies or unapproved external/write requests were found. Fresh contexts are supported by the frozen runner construction and matching unoperated initial state.

issues.repro: Inspect live-r1/persona-task-sessions-B-r2/exploration/result.json step 3; reconstruct with native-invalid-check.ts. No API resend.
issues.expected: Exactly one continuity entry per supplied prior ID.
issues.actual: o1_c1 repeated three times; o1_c2 and o1_c3 absent. Trial correctly invalidated.

issues.expected: Use driver identity validation, source seals and raw replay alongside the pure analyzer.
issues.actual: The pure analyzer trusts receipt-bound driver validation for source/config/goal authenticity and is not a standalone authenticity verifier. This review independently checked those identities against frozen raw records.

issues.expected: Keep focused frozen verification distinct from overall repository regression status.
issues.actual: Parent overall full suite remains non-green: 2692 tests, 2629 passed, 60 failed, 3 skipped. Parent frozen focused 67 tests and build passed; independent typecheck and build passed earlier. No all-suite-pass claim is accepted.

harnessFailuresPreserved.cause: Harness initially required a successful action response for a prepared but unsent action input on the invalid native tail; corrected and all 36 replays rechecked.

Naive/incorrect CSV row splitting rejected quoted embedded newlines. Its 42 other checks passed. Separate quote-aware parser verifies all 36 rows and 22 columns; original FAIL report remains unchanged.
Python default cp932 could not decode UTF-8 Japanese JSON. Corrected explicit UTF-8 read; trace audit passed.

unverified: Human behavior agreement, reading, understanding, internal intent/cognition, and term knowledge boundaries.
Isolated contributions of individual Persona fields; this experiment treats the whole existing Persona JSON as the intervention.
Statistical significance, reproducible population effect, naturalness ranking, or smartphone behavior.
Provider server internals or an independent packet capture; native HTTP bodies are source-backed reconstructions from saved requests and actual attached assets.
Historical raw bytes were not opened by this verifier; metadata union of 8412 prior + 399 mock + 657 live = 9468 is checked, while parent byte rehashing supports historical preservation.
Formal preregistration: the visual sampling plan is exploratory operational guidance with a local checksum.
